effect_description_eng:
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may link 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, you may suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend in their next unsuspend phase.
